title: Grand Canyon South Rim and Route 66 with Lunch
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Please Note: National Park fees may apply for international visitors. If applicable, this fee is collected in-destination and not at the time of booking.

blurb:
Discover the South Rim of the Grand Canyon on this full-day tour from Las Vegas. Travel by deluxe motor coach and enjoy views of the Mojave Desert along the way. Enjoy three hours at the national park, where you can explore highlights like views of the deepest and widest part of the canyon from Mather Point, historic Hopi House, and the Bright Angel Trail.
